notes.title: Bugtopia Update 1.0.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Bugtopia has officially been out for one week!
Over the past week, we've received a wide variety of feedback and suggestions. Thanks to all your support and encouragement, our dev bugs are more motivated than ever! Compared to the 1.0 launch version, the current Bugtopia has seen improvements in many areas—thank you so much!

Many players have also shared their hopes for future updates, including new features and more bugs. We've taken note of them all! Once we've prioritized and resolved the most pressing issues, we'll do our best to meet your expectations.

We've also noticed recent issues with the save system, and we're taking them very seriously. We're actively working to optimize this system and make the game more stable.

Here's a look at what's been changed in the past couple of days:

[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where certain synergy effects were not working correctly
[*] Fixed incorrect growth progress display for some bugs
[*] Fixed incorrect placement marker for the Pink lotus
[*] Fixed sound error for certain baby bug
[/list]

[h1][b]Optimizations[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved achievement condition logic
[*] Optimized pathing for certain landscaping items
[*] Improved some text descriptions
[*] Adjusted breeding probabilities
[*] Balanced growth values for some bugs
[*] Balanced income from certain bugs
[*] Improved sound samples for the Treehopper
[/list]

[h1][b]Save System Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a feature to automatically load a backup save if the main save encounters an issue
[*] Added automatic deletion for corrupted save files
[/list]

[h1][b]Bug Reports[/b][/h1]
If you run into other bugs or issues, you can go to:
Settings (bottom-right corner or ESC) → Function → Bug
and fill out the bug report form.

For tricky or complex issues, feel free to join our Discord!

You're also welcome to join our official player community to raise bugs and chat all things buggy with us!

Thanks again for your support and for playing Bugtopia!

notes.title: Bugtopia Update 1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello to all the new bug keepers!

Bugtopia is officially out now—thank you all for playing! We've already spotted some in-game issues and released an urgent v1.0.1 patch to address them.

In addition, we've compiled answers to several frequently asked questions. We've also received tons of great suggestions and feedback—thank you! We'll be sharing an update roadmap soon, including upcoming features and content.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed incorrect bug descriptions
[*] Fixed missing fonts in certain places
[*] Fixed specific animation errors
[*] Fixed tutorial issues caused by tool purchases
[*] Fixed tutorial issues caused by interaction animations
[*] Fixed an issue where certain special cases in the tutorial could cause the player to get completely stuck
[/list]

[h1]FAQ[/h1]
[h3]Can I skip the tutorial?[/h3]
Yes! Press T in-game to skip the tutorial manually. After completing the tutorial once, you can unlock and sell the Guide. (Don't worry—you can always bring it back later by buying a return ticket!)

[h3]Can I carry over my demo save to the full version?[/h3]
Saves are not directly compatible, but you can inherit your demo currency by going to the bottom-right corner of the main menu:
Settings → Function → Load Demo Save Files.
If you unlocked and bought the Spiky Isopod in the demo, you'll also receive an exclusive landscaping item in the full version!

[h3]Why can’t I feed bugs in the pupal stage anymore?[/h3]
To better reflect real-life ecosystems, pupae in the full version no longer eat feed! (It’s a design choice—not a bug~)

[h1]Bug Reports[/h1]
If you run into other bugs or issues, you can go to:
Settings (bottom-right corner or ESC) → Function → Bug
and fill out the bug report form.

For tricky or complex issues, feel free to join our Discord!

You're also welcome to join our official player community to raise bugs and chat all things buggy with us!

Thanks again for your support and for playing Bugtopia!

notes.title: 🐝Bugtopia Releases on May 22nd! Spend a Wonderful Summer with Bugs!
notes.content:
Hello players! Our indie game Bugtopia will officially launch on May 22nd!

Bugtopia is an idle game about insect cultivation. You might have played various idle games before—raising fish, growing flowers, farming and more—but Bugtopia stands out with its diverse insect species. We've designed 300 types of bugs and added features like DIY terrarium landscapes.

Your screen becomes your first terrarium! We hope this relaxing and soothing idle game brings you a moment of calm amidst your busy work or studies, allowing you to discover the joy of insects.

Release Version Features:
- 300 bugs based on real-life species, including bioluminescent and sound-producing insects. Breed them to unlock rare variants—many. Many surprises await!
- 300 decorative items with 700+ variations, obtainable through idle progression or manually switching to your favorite styles.
- 78 types of water, soil and wallpaper to create ever-changing ecosphere landscapes.
- 5 time periods and 4 weather effects, make your ecosphere a dynamic mini-ecosystem.
- Desktop (wallpaper) mode and borderless windowed mode for easy viewing anytime.
- Pomodoro timer with periodic focus reminders to accompany work (or breaks!)
- 3 feeding robots and other hidden easter eggs—long-term play stays fun!

Don't forget to wishlist Bugtopia now!
